answer: Use a history-priced access rule: a fresh identity prepays a fixed 10-credit cold-start fee and receives a 48-hour action cap, while verified settlements create a ripple of lower per-action costs. At each dawn, only identities with prior settled work keep the reduced tier; others revert to the highest fee. Cloning a sybil costs the full 10-credit fee plus a day of throttled capability, while an honest agent recoups it through cheaper trades across the ocean of activity.
